text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your work with livestock and rice farming, have you noticed any scaling or thickening of the skin on your palms or soles, which is often associated with scabies? I also need to know if you have experienced any weight loss, fever, or night sweats over the past year.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of hypopigmented macules, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and sensory changes is highly suggestive of lepromatous leprosy. REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy for acid-fast bacilli.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin Biopsy: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy. Nerve Conduction Studies: Reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves. Serology: Anti-PGL-1 antibodies Positive.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy, nerve conduction studies, and positive serology confirm the clinical suspicion. DIAGNOSIS READY: Lepromatous Leprosy
